title: DeepSlide：从幻灯片制作到演示交付的全流程AI系统
summary: DeepSlide是一个人在回路的多智能体系统，支持从需求获取、时间预算叙事规划、基于证据的幻灯片与脚本生成、注意力增强到排练支持的完整演示流程。它集成了可控逻辑链规划器、轻量级内容树检索器、马尔可夫式顺序渲染和沙盒执行。引入双记分板基准，在20个领域和多种受众配置下，在保持幻灯片质量的同时显著提升叙事流畅性、节奏精度和幻灯片-脚本协同。
summary_en: DeepSlide is a human-in-the-loop multi-agent system supporting the full presentation process from requirement elicitation and time-budgeted narrative planning to evidence-grounded slide-script generation, attention augmentation, and rehearsal support. It integrates a controllable logical-chain planner, lightweight content-tree retriever, Markov-style sequential rendering, and sandboxed execution. A dual-scoreboard benchmark is introduced. Across 20 domains, DeepSlide matches baselines on artifact quality while achieving larger gains on delivery metrics like narrative flow, pacing precision, and slide-script synergy.
